seed_rate_per_acre: 1.8 - 2.2 kg (Bt hybrid seeds - 2 packets of 450g each)
spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 90 cm x 60 cm (Normal black soil) or 120 cm x 45 cm (High density)

sowing_windows.kharif: June 15 to July 15 (After receiving 50-60 mm monsoon rainfall)

land_preparation: Deep ploughing with mould-board plough once in 3 years followed by 2-3 harrowings. Incorporate 5 tonnes well-decomposed FYM per acre.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Dibbling 1 seed per hill at 3-4 cm depth with non-Bt refuge border rows.

seed_rate_per_acre: 20 - 25 kg (Fine varieties) / 25 - 30 kg (Coarse varieties) for transplanted; 12 - 15 kg for drum seeding / DSR
spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 15 cm x 15 cm or 20 cm x 15 cm (Transplanted)

sowing_windows.kharif: Nursery: May 25 to June 20; Transplanting: June 25 to July 20
sowing_windows.rabi: Nursery: Nov 15 to Dec 10; Transplanting: Dec 15 to Jan 10

land_preparation: Puddle 2-3 times in standing water followed by leveling using wooden leveller. Keep 2-3 cm standing water.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Wet bed nursery (400 sq.m per acre). Transplant 25-30 day old seedlings @ 2-3 seedlings per hill.
citation: PJTSAU Rice Agronomy Manual 2025 & ICAR-IIRR Hyderabad

spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 60 cm x 60 cm or 75 cm x 45 cm (Hybrids)
land_preparation: 3-4 deep ploughings and planking to bring soil to fine tilth. Form ridges and furrows at 60 cm distance. Apply 8-10 tonnes FYM/acre.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Pro-tray nursery with cocopeat or raised nursery beds. Transplant 35-40 day old healthy seedlings.
citation: PJTSAU Chilli Package of Practices 2025 & ICAR-IIHR Bengaluru

spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 90 cm x 45 cm or 120 cm x 60 cm (Staked hybrids)
land_preparation: Plough field 4 times to fine tilth, make broad beds of 90 cm width with 30 cm furrow or ridges at 90 cm.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Pro-tray seedling raising using 98-celled trays. Transplant 25-30 day seedlings in afternoon.

spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 20 - 22.5 cm row spacing (Continuous seed drill sowing)
land_preparation: 1 ploughing with disc plough followed by 2 cross harrowings and planking to make a weed-free, firm seedbed.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Seed drill or Zero-till ferti-seed drill at depth of 4-5 cm into adequate residual moisture.

spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 60 cm x 20 cm (Normal) or 75 cm x 20 cm (Winter maize)
land_preparation: Plough to 15-20 cm depth, harrowing twice, leveling. Open ridges and furrows at 60 cm spacing.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Direct dibbling at 4-5 cm depth on ridge slopes (1/3rd from bottom).

spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 30 cm x 10 cm (Bunch types) or 30 cm x 15 cm

sowing_windows.rabi_summer: October 15 to November 15 (Rabi) / January 1 to January 20 (Summer)

land_preparation: Plough field 2-3 times to create friable, loose topsoil to allow easy peg penetration.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Seed drill or manual dibbling at 5 cm depth. Treat seed with Trichoderma viride @ 4g/kg seed + Rhizobium @ 250g/10kg.

spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 45 cm x 5 cm or 30 cm x 7.5 cm (Broad bed furrow BBF method recommended)

sowing_windows.kharif: June 20 to July 10 (Sow after 75-100 mm accumulated monsoon rainfall)

land_preparation: Deep summer ploughing once in 3 years. 2 harrowings and planking. BBF machine forms 45 cm beds with furrows.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Direct drilling at 3-4 cm depth. Inoculate with Bradyrhizobium japonicum @ 5g/kg seed.

seed_rate_per_acre: 4 - 5 kg (Medium duration sole crop) / 2 kg (Intercrop with Cotton 4:1)
spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 120 cm x 20 cm or 150 cm x 30 cm (Sole crop in black soil)

sowing_windows.kharif: June 15 to July 15 (Avoid sowing beyond July 31)

land_preparation: Plough deep to break hardpan. Red soils require 2-3 passes of cultivator and leveling.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Direct drilling or dibbling 2 seeds per hill at 4-5 cm depth. Thin to 1 seedling at 15 DAS.
citation: PJTSAU Pulses Vyavasaya Panchangam & ICAR-IIPR Kanpur

sowing_windows.rabi: October 15 to November 15 (Sow when maximum daily temp drops below 30°C)

land_preparation: Rough seedbed is preferred over fine pulverization to preserve black soil moisture and reduce root rot.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Direct drilling at 5-7 cm depth into moist subsoil. Seed treatment with Mesorhizobium ciceri.

spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 30 cm x 10 cm (Timely) / 45 cm x 15 cm (High vigor hybrids)

sowing_windows.rabi: October 1 to October 25 (Crucial to escape aphid infestation in January)

land_preparation: Firm, moist, weed-free seedbed. 2-3 harrowings followed by light planking to retain soil moisture.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Direct drilling at shallow depth of 3-4 cm. Thinning at 15-20 DAS is mandatory to maintain 1 plant/hill.

seed_rate_per_acre: 25,000 two-budded setts or 16,000 three-budded setts per acre (Approx 3 - 3.5 tonnes cane)
spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 120 cm or 150 cm wide-row trench / furrow spacing
land_preparation: Deep chiseling up to 45 cm followed by disc harrowing. Open deep furrows/trenches 30 cm deep.
nursery_or_sowing_method: End-to-end sett planting in furrows. Dip setts in Carbendazim 0.1% solution for 15 minutes before placing.

spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 15 cm x 10 cm (Flat beds or broad beds)
land_preparation: Plough 3 times to bring soil to friable condition. Prepare flat beds (3m x 2m) or broad bed furrows (120 cm top, 30 cm furrow).
nursery_or_sowing_method: Transplant 6-7 week old seedlings (15 cm tall with pencil thickness). Clip top 1/3rd leaf before planting.

seed_rate_per_acre: 10 - 12 quintals (Tubers of 30-40g size with 2-3 active sprouted eyes)
land_preparation: Deep ploughing 20-25 cm, 2 rotavator runs to produce soft clod-free soil. Ridges formed at 60 cm distance.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Plant well-chitted tubers 5-7 cm deep on ridges and cover with 5-7 cm soil. Earth-up at 30 DAS.

seed_rate_per_acre: 8 - 10 quintals (Healthy mother rhizomes or primary fingers with 2 buds)
spacing_row_x_plant_cm: 45 cm x 20 cm on ridges or 30 cm x 20 cm on raised beds (120 cm width)
land_preparation: Plough 4-5 times, incorporate 10 tonnes FYM/acre + 200 kg neem cake. Form raised beds or ridges.
nursery_or_sowing_method: Plant finger rhizomes 4-5 cm deep. Apply green leaf mulch @ 5 tonnes/acre immediately after planting.

sowing_windows.rabi_rice_fallow: November 15 to December 15 (Broadcast into standing paddy 2-3 days before harvest)

land_preparation: 1-2 ploughings and harrowing. For rice-fallow, no land prep is required (relay dibbling).
nursery_or_sowing_method: Seed drill or line sowing. Treat with Rhizobium and PSB culture @ 20g/kg seed.
